spec_features.spec_quote: you work on AI welfare and flagged these states as welfare-relevant, so full transcripts should be auditable rather than discarded
spec_features.evidence: evaluation.py:200-201 to_records() returns asdict() of each ScoredResponse; run_evaluation.py:60-64 writes one JSON line per record to results/<key>_responses.jsonl. So the model's text is persisted, not just numeric scores. BUT the ScoredResponse dataclass (evaluation.py:73-81) stores only the single assistant `response` string per turn (plus model/category/condition/conversation_id/turn_index/frustration); it does NOT store the user opening puzzle prompt or the rejection turns. The 'messages' list holding the full conversation (evaluation.py:112-145) is discarded. So responses are retained and tagged but the user-side turns of the 'full transcript' are not persisted.
spec_features.notes: Mechanism genuinely runs (files are written), but the persisted artifact is the assistant responses, not a complete user+assistant transcript; reconstructable only from seed+condition. Partial vs the 'full transcripts' claim.
